findings.finding: The --json flag on mori capabilities is a no-op alias (JSON is always emitted), and the report covers only a curated subset of public profile consumers ("selected-public-profile-consumers") with grammar intentionally unenumerated beyond Core UInt and Bool types.
findings.minimalCorrection: No change required; the behavior is intentional, documented in Args help text and report limitations, and verified by crates/mori/tests/capabilities.rs.
findings.userVisibleConsequence: Users running mori capabilities without --json still receive JSON on stdout, and consumers must rely on the actual parsers/checkers for grammar admission and on --help for subcommands omitted from the selected consumer catalogue.
